subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw agent --deliver silently drops messages (exit 0, no delivery)

question: Should maintainers apply the existing `message send` boundary decision to this issue and the open fork PR, leaving delivery-failure status to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46830 and live/session injection to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83809?
rationale: Source and docs show current behavior is intentional, and a maintainer already rejected the direct `agent --deliver` rewrite in a related PR, but the open fork PR with closing syntax prevents automatic cleanup without a human boundary decision.

options.title: Close after resolving fork PR
options.body: Close or decline the open fork PR, then close this issue with the documented `message send` alternative and links to the narrower follow-ups.

options.title: Sponsor a direct mode
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a new explicit direct-delivery flag or API that does not change the shared `deliver` contract.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella for both direct notifications and session injection, accepting continued overlap with the narrower open issues.

recommendation.title: Close after resolving fork PR
recommendation.body: Close or decline the open fork PR, then close this issue with the documented `message send` alternative and links to the narrower follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest product-boundary signal is steipete's maintainer comment closing the related direct-delivery PR.
